name: Leif Erikson's voyage to Vinland
summary: Leif Erikson, son of Erik the Red, sails from Greenland and establishes a brief Norse settlement at L'Anse aux Meadows on northern Newfoundland. Subsequent expeditions by Thorfinn Karlsefni encounter indigenous peoples ('Skrælings'); the colony is abandoned within a generation.

_quarry.structural_significance: First European contact with the Americas, ~500 years before Columbus. The L'Anse aux Meadows site (excavated 1960s, UNESCO World Heritage 1978) is the only Norse settlement in the Americas yet identified archaeologically; the saga accounts have been vindicated by physical evidence.
